nd.screen.hint: The native desktop on the monitor plugged into this box.
nd.full.hint: NoCap OS itself on this screen, running natively, fr: the NoCapOS sign-in, the same menu bar, dock, launcher and widgets as in the browser, and NoCap's apps (Files, Terminal, Photos, Settings, the App Store) in their own windows, plus any Linux apps you add. Sign in with this server's Linux accounts.
nd.off.hint: Just the text console. Nothing graphical runs, pure server energy.
nd.noScreen: No screen detected rn. Plug one in to use NoCap Desktop.
nd.notSetUp: NoCap Desktop isn't set up on this server yet.
nd.confirmBody: Whoever is signed in on the server's screen gets signed out, and unsaved stuff there is gone.
nd.autologin.hint: The server's screen opens your desktop with no password after it starts. Anyone at the screen can use it, so choose wisely.
nd.open.hint: See and use the server's screen right here, in a window. Same screen, always: sign in here and you're in on the screen too.
nd.win.signIn: Sign-in screen. Sign in here and the server's screen is in too
nd.win.switching: Following the screen to its new session…
nd.win.closedBody: The screen dipped. The desktop may have restarted or signed out.
nd.win.title: The server's screen
nd.health.ok: All good, NoCap Desktop is on the screen
nd.health.broken: Something's off: the screen may be black
nd.health.p.not_at_boot: The sign-in screen isn't set to start when the server boots.
nd.health.p.not_graphical: The server boots to the text console, not the desktop.
nd.health.p.dm_failed: The sign-in screen crashed and stopped.
nd.health.p.no_shell: The sign-in screen runs, but nothing ever showed up on the screen (that's the black screen).
nd.health.p.no_nocap_shell: NoCap Desktop's own programs or pages are missing.
nd.health.p.no_greeter: The sign-in service isn't set to show the NoCapOS sign-in screen.
nd.health.p.no_session: The NoCapOS session files are missing.
nd.health.p.no_xwayland: Xwayland isn't installed, so older X11 apps won't open.
nd.health.p.kiosk_left: Bits of the old web full screen are still here.
nd.health.p.services_held: The installer left services on hold.
nd.health.fallback.software: Drawing with the processor (software rendering) so it works here.
nd.repair.hint: Fixes the boot setup, brings back missing session and sign-in settings, clears old leftovers and, if the screen stays black, switches to software rendering. Then the screen restarts.
nd.repair.confirmBody: The server's screen restarts. Whoever is signed in there gets signed out, and unsaved stuff there is gone.
nd.repair.done: NoCap Desktop repaired, the screen is restarting
nd.diag.hint: The logs behind the screen: sign-in service, window system, NoCap Desktop, sessions, graphics card. Copy them when you ask for help.
nd.health.p.other_dm: The old desktop's sign-in service is still running next to NoCap Desktop.
nd.repair.restartNeeded: Fixed what it could. Someone's still on the old desktop, so the switch waits for a restart
nd.restart.hint: The old desktop still has the screen ({users} is signed in there). Restart the server and NoCap Desktop takes over.
nd.restart.title: Restart the server now?
nd.restart.body: The old desktop still has the screen ({users} is signed in there). Restarting signs them out, and unsaved stuff there is gone. After the restart, NoCap Desktop is on the screen.
nd.old.title: Old desktop leftovers
nd.old.hint: NoCap Desktop has been running solid here, so the old desktop's packages NoCapOS put in can go: {list}. Anything else that still needs them keeps them.
nd.old.keepList: Staying no matter what (you or something else installed them): {list}
nd.old.confirmBody: These go, plus whatever only they needed: {list}. Your files and settings stay. This takes a few minutes.
nd.old.kept: Got it, the old desktop stays
